Package com.csse3200.game.cards.deck

Class PlayerDeck

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.deck.PlayerDeck
public class PlayerDeck extends Object
Stores the cards owned by the player outside a single combat encounter.

The deck stores Team 6 card IDs instead of full card definitions. Card data, costs, targets and effects should be resolved through the card library when another system needs the full card configuration. This keeps the player deck independent from combat-only state such as draw pile, hand and discard pile.

Each owned copy is tracked as a CardInstance. Definition-level acquisition accepts a card ID and creates a fresh instance, while lookup, removal and upgrade operations accept an instance ID so duplicate copies are never selected by accident.

    • addCard

      public void addCard(CardInstance card)
      Adds an existing card instance to the end of the deck, preserving its instance ID and upgrade level exactly rather than generating a fresh instance ID. Used when restoring a saved deck, so each card comes back as the same physical copy the player owned before.
      Parameters:
      card - the exact card instance to add
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the card is invalid or its instance ID is already owned

    • canAddCard

      public boolean canAddCard(String cardId)
      Checks whether a card may be added to this player deck.

      Sprint 1 allows duplicate cards and has no deck-size limit, so this check only verifies that the card ID is registered. This method does not modify the deck.

      Parameters:
      cardId - card ID to check
      Returns:
      true if the card can be added, otherwise false
